mentions.name: Hatamoto
mentions.description: A web platform designed as a complete replacement for WordPress and its most-used plugins, all built into the system. It ships as a single Go binary with no Node and no compilation, runs on Postgres, supports sandboxed plugins, and includes built-in AI analytics.
mentions.problem: WordPress depends on separate installs of its most-used plugins and complex tooling (Node, compilation); this consolidates everything into one Go binary.
